svg.title: Two processes with the same ΔU
svg.desc: (a) A system takes in Q_in = 40 J and gives off Q_out = −25 J of heat (net 15 J in); it has W_in = −4 J of work done on it and does W_out = 10 J (net 6 J out), so ΔU = Q − W = 15 J − 6 J = +9 J. (b) A different system gives off 150 J of heat (Q_out = −150 J) while 159 J of work is done on it (W = −159 J), so ΔU = −150 J − (−159 J) = +9 J, the same change.
